page.notes: Greek headwords in the middle column (between "Pherezei" and "Phinees") were not legible to me letter by letter and are marked [?]; they are printed in Greek and I have not guessed them. Several page numbers in the middle and right columns are blurred (e.g. "Pharisaei 45 a. 469 a", "pij hominis iudicium 194 a", "pietatis sensus unde 8 b") and may be misread. The signature "4" at lower left is doubtful. No page number is printed on this scan. The running head is "INDEX" (the printed "X." is left out). The strip at the left edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
